name: desk-art
description: Make character art with the image generators already on this Mac (Codex, Antigravity, the Gemini app), no API keys of its own, and file every picture into one inbox

inboxDir.title: Art inbox folder
inboxDir.description: Where finished pictures are filed (keep it outside the game repo)

refFolders.title: Folders pictures may be sent from
refFolders.description: Pictures you give Claude as references are uploaded to OpenAI or Google. Only pictures inside these folders can be sent. Separate folders with a vertical bar (|). Leave it empty to use the game's own art folders.
